title: How It Works, explained
audience: Engineers who want to know how a verified tutorial video is made
outcome: Follow a storyboard from plan to a delivered, verified video

scenes.title: Plan the story
scenes.narration: It starts with a storyboard: every scene, action, and line of narration. Validate checks it before anything runs.

guide.step: Write a {label} with scenes, actions, and narration. **Validate** rejects unknown fields, ids, and targets before any work starts.

scenes.title: Capture the product
scenes.narration: Capture drives the real product with real clicks and keystrokes, and keeps frames, timings, and page text as evidence.

guide.step: **Capture** drives the real product. **Evidence** keeps timestamped frames, element boxes, and page text.

scenes.title: Compose the video
scenes.narration: Narration adds a voice with word timings. Compose turns evidence and voice into motion, captions, and sound.

guide.step: **Narration** returns audio with word timings. **Compose** syncs camera, captions, and sound effects to the recorded events.

scenes.title: Render and verify
scenes.narration: Render produces the video and the guide. Quality gates check labels, loudness, and reading speed.

guide.step: **Render** produces the video and guide. **Quality Gates** check UI labels, loudness, caption speed, and black frames.

scenes.title: Deliver with proof
scenes.narration: Only when every gate passes does Deliver write the files, with a receipt anyone can verify.

guide.step: **Deliver** writes files only after every gate passes, with a SHA-256 receipt.

scenes.title: The whole loop
scenes.narration: That is the whole loop: plan, capture, produce, and verify, every time.
